name: Booster Robotics
summary: Booster Robotics is a Chinese embodied AI startup led by CEO Cheng Hao. It makes developer humanoids (T1, T2, K1) widely used in robot soccer and research.
funding: Series A+ of over 100 million yuan (about $13.9 million) in July 2025, backed by Beijing robot and AI industry funds (Caixin).

sources.title: China's Booster Robotics Lands New Funding as it Hits a Winning Streak
